text:
maya: Quick planning thread for next week's community quickstart + micro OSS launch. Scope: 3 short tutorials (how-to), 1 lightweight refapp repo, 20-min demo webinar, social kit, and a short benchmark blurb. Owners?

sam: I'll take lead on webinar logistics & CTAs. Date suggestion: Thu 11am PT. :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll own tutorial content + refapp. Plan 3 topics: chat integration, embeddings search, and cost-optimized serving pattern. Need perf numbers for the benchmark blurb. @kyle can you run latency/cost apples-to-apples vs hosted?

kyle: Yep. Running a small perf matrix today. Will post p50/p95, throughput, and a cost-per-1M-token estimate. Example run command I'll use:
```bash
./run_bench --model redwood-3b --mode dedicated --batch 4 --seq 256 --out results.csv
```

olga: I'll design hero + 4 tweet cards. Need final title + single stat to feature by Tue noon. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/quickstart-kits

maya: Messaging angle idea: "Get started fast with predictable inference—reference apps, benchmarks, and code you can fork." Thoughts?

sam: For the benchmark narrative, highlight real dev workflows: chat latency with prefix caching, and embeddings rerank cost. Show impact of batching & KV cache. Keep numbers simple for social.

jordan: Webinar format: 20-min demo (refapp walkthrough + perf comparison) + 10-min live Q&A. I'll prepare 3 pre-submitted demo questions for the panel.

kyle: Posting initial numbers in a sec. Rough: p95=140ms (dedicated), p95 hosted=180ms, estimated cost delta ~$0.004/token savings when using caching + batching. Will refine.

analytics-bot: New analytics alert: signup funnel test ready on /signup?utm_campaign=quickstart-launch&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social

maya: Inbound lead routing: @sam please set the webhook to SFDC sandbox. Suggested mapping: campaign=quickstart-launch, lead_owner=marketing_followup. Use this curl as example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.sfdc.sandbox/api/leads -d '{"utm_campaign":"quickstart-launch","source":"twitter","email":"{{email}}"}'
```

sam: Will wire it up and add UTM template to the landing page. Also setting auto-assign rule to marketing queue for first touch.

olga: Draft hero concepts by Monday EOD. Need the single stat from @kyle to lock copy.

kyle: Finalized numbers: p95(dedicated)=128ms, p95(hosted)=175ms, cost per 1M tokens: dedicated ~$1,200 vs hosted ~$1,800 (with caching+batching assumptions). Use the p95 delta for social card.

maya: Great. I'll draft the launch post + thread for X and a short blog outline. Dropping drafts Tue 9am. Thanks team! :rocket:
